value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor should be mostly sunny from late morning through the afternoon, with a high around 29 to 30°C. Expect a chance of showers, maybe a thunderstorm, early in the morning. The wind picks up from mid-afternoon into the evening, with west gusts up to 50 km/h. Showers are likely overnight, possibly with a thunderstorm.
